summary: Created and opened `desk:apps:temp`; it starts empty and shows `F: ?`.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give ''
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'backspace'
when count(s) > 0
give slice(s, 1, count(s) - 1)
done
give s
done
when ('0123456789' has k) or k is '.' or k is '-'
give s & k
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s)
when is_number(s)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & (number(s) * 9 / 5 + 32))
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
done
